Subject: Request: pen test report and SOC2 evidence mapping

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of our SOC 2 scoping exercise (Type II, in Q1), our security team has a few requests we need to validate for procurement:

- Full penetration test report for the last 12 months (or executive summary + confirmed remediation log)
- A mapping of PT findings to SOC 2 control families (or SIG/CAIQ references where applicable)
- A formal statement on what will be redacted and why for any shared artifacts

We understand redaction is common; Acme's security team needs a clear sanitization matrix and an auditable delivery path (secure viewer or escrow) so our auditors can verify remediation. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:

1) Share an exec summary immediately under NDA
2) Provide a secure, time-limited viewer for auditors with watermarking
3) Supply sanitized supporting evidence (screenshots/log extracts) tied to the findings matrix

Appreciate a proposed timeline — procurement is targeting a vendor selection decision week of Jan 11.

Best,
Sam

--

Sam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can comply but need to align on legal gating (NDA) and the redaction granularity up front so your auditors aren't blocked. Proposal below is our recommended path to keep things auditable while protecting sensitive exploit detail:

High-level plan (timeline in business days):
- Day 0 (today): Share Draft_NDA for countersignature (attached)
- Day 1-2: Receive signed NDA — send Exec Summary (PDF) and Sanitization_Matrix.xlsx
- Day 3-7: Provision secure viewer (DocSend-like) for Acme security + auditor list (watermark, IP & email overlay, disable download, session logs)
- Day 8-14: Deliver sanitized evidence bundle (screenshots, log extracts, remediation steps) mapped to SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2 families

Key notes:
- Exec summary will include severity, impacted components, remediation status, and verification notes. It will NOT include exploit PoC code or raw memory dumps.
- Sanitization_Matrix.xlsx will list each finding ID, proposed redaction fields, and justification (legal, customer data, 3rd-party IP).
- For auditors who require deeper inspection, we offer a monitored remote session with a member of our infra team (timeboxed) where we can reproduce findings in a sanitized lab environment.

We can also add a short mutual action plan (MAP) into DocuSign for signatures if that helps procurement track milestones.

Attaching: Draft_NDA_Acme_Redwood.docx (legal), Redwood_PT_ExecSummary_v1.pdf (preview), Sanitization_Matrix.xlsx (workbook).

Action items for Acme: please confirm the list of external auditors (names + emails) who should be given viewer access, and sign the attached NDA so we can proceed.

Thanks,
Aditya

Sam —

Quick legal note following Aditya's plan. Our standard approach for pen test sharing is:

1) NDA in place covering shared reports (we've attached a one-way mutual NDA for speed).
2) Redaction principles: redact exploit payloads, ephemeral credentials, and third-party customer data. We will not redact the root cause or remediation actions; those remain visible.
3) Audit access: we will provide a limited-time, view-only link with session logging. For auditors requesting offline copies for evidence retention, we require a signed evidence handling addendum (we can attach a short form).

If Acme procurement requires retention of the full report in their records, we can negotiate an escrow arrangement under which Redwood provides a sealed copy to the auditor under a specific charter (timeboxed access).

If you can confirm NDA signers and whether auditors need transferable copies for their SOC process, we will route the correct paperwork.

Thanks,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security

Aditya/Laura —

Thanks for the proposal, that timeline looks workable. A few clarifications from Acme:

- We'll sign the NDA today and return with a list of two auditors (external-auditor@horizon-audit.com and emma.liu@indigo-audit.com). Please provision viewer access for both emails.
- Our auditors will want a sealed copy for their internal working files. If Redwood can provide an escrow path (sealed copy to auditor under charter), that would satisfy our compliance team.
- Regarding the monitored remote session: we prefer a recorded, time-limited screen-share with your engineer who reproduced the remediation steps. The recording will be treated as confidential evidence by our auditor.

One request on the Sanitization_Matrix: can you add a column mapping each finding to the corresponding SOC 2 CC or CAIQ control identifier? That will speed validation.

If you can update the matrix and return the exec summary + viewer link once NDA is signed, procurement should be able to finalize vendor shortlist next week.

I'll attach the signed NDA in my next message.

Sam
